segments.caption: A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging among the branches. It uses its paws to grasp and pull at twigs and buds, occasionally looking around its surroundings, with buildings visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched in a leafy tree, actively foraging for food. It stands on its hind legs, using its paws to pull down and eat the fresh, light-green blossoms or buds from the branches. The bear is focused on its meal, occasionally looking up, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched in a leafy tree, actively feeding on the blossoms. It shifts its position, using its paws to grip branches as it moves and looks around, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a tree with fresh green blossoms, actively feeding on the flowers. It holds onto branches with its paws, tilting its head back as it eats, with a building visible in the background.

A large brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively feeding on the fresh green blossoms. It stands on its hind legs, using its front paws to grasp branches and pull at the clusters of flowers, its head moving as it eats. The scene is set in an urban or suburban environment, with multi-story buildings visible in the background through the tree branches.
A brown bear is actively climbing through the branches of a leafy, blossoming tree, with a building visible in the background.
A brown bear is seen climbing and settling into a tree with fresh green blossoms, its body partially obscured by branches as it looks around, with a building visible in the background.
A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging among the branches and blossoms, with a building visible in the background.
A brown bear is seen climbing and navigating through the branches of a leafy tree, with a river and buildings visible in the background.

Two bears are seen climbing and interacting within the branches of a leafy tree near a body of water, with one bear actively moving up the trunk while the other remains partially obscured among the foliage.

A family of brown bears is actively climbing a leafy tree by a riverbank, with cubs scrambling up the trunk and branches while an adult bear is positioned higher up, all set against the backdrop of rippling water and a crowd of onlookers visible below.
Three brown bears are actively climbing a leafy tree near a river, with a crowd of spectators watching from a nearby viewing platform.

Two young brown bears are seen climbing a tree trunk in a zoo or wildlife park enclosure, with one bear higher up and the other below it. They are positioned near a body of water, and a glass-bottomed walkway with tourists observing them is visible in the background, reflecting in the water. The bears continue their ascent, showcasing their natural climbing ability, while the onlookers watch from above.

Two young brown bears are playfully interacting around a tree trunk in a grassy enclosure beside a body of water; one climbs the tree while the other watches from below, eventually joining it at the base before both settle down together.

Two brown bears, likely a mother and her cub, are seen in a sunlit, grassy, wooded area. Initially, they are nestled together at the base of a tree. The cub then moves away from the mother, and both bears proceed to walk together across the ground, exploring their surroundings.
A mother bear and her cub walk together across a grassy, wooded area, with the cub following closely behind its mother as they move steadily through the natural habitat.
